skill.displayName: AI Face Merge: Free Online AI Face Morph & Face Merge Tool – CLI-powered
skill.summary: AI face merge — blend two faces together into a single realistic portrait

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-face-merge-cli-skill.
- Blend two face images into a single realistic portrait using the weshop CLI.
- Requires weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Includes a secure workflow for handling API keys—never expose your key on the command line.
- Supports custom prompts and batching; Image 2 serves as the baseline for merging.
- Detailed output includes result status and direct URLs to merged images.
